Each Root Behemoth is usually accompanied by several [[Life Pod]]s. ==Locations== * [[Maguuma Jungle]] ** {{NPC location|Dry Top}} ** {{NPC location|Mamnoon Lagoon}} ** {{NPC location|Tangle Root}} ** {{NPC location|The Falls}} ==Missions== * Maguuma Jungle ** {{NPC location|Aurora Glade}} ** {{NPC location|Bloodstone Fen}} ==Skills== * {{skill icon|"I Will Survive!"}} * {{skill icon|Deflect Arrows}} * {{skill icon|Earth Shaker}} ([[elite]], [[Hard mode]] only) * {{skill icon|Wild Blow}} ==Armor ratings== {{NPC statistics | prof = w | blunt = 97 | piercing = 97 | slashing = 97 | cold = 77 | earth = 77 | fire = 77 | lightning = 77 }} ==Items dropped== * [[Behemoth Jaw]] * [[Chitin Fragment]] * [[Monstrous Claw]] * [[Totem Axe]] ([[unique]]; only in The Falls) ==Notes== * Despite being a Warrior, Root Behemoths can attack from [[bow]] range. * The Life Pods [[popup]] when you get close to the Root Behemoths. Be careful approaching clustered Root Behemoths in Hard mode, since it can be very difficult to kill more than three or four Life Pods at once. If this happens, break [[aggro]] and attempt to [[pull]] the different groups apart. [[Category:Drops chitin]] [[Category:Drops monstrous claw]] [[Category:Non-boss NPCs with Unique Items]]
